provider: Mail.ru Cloud / Облако Mail (VK) — 1 TB with free public-link download

free_tier.stated: 1 TB plan. Landing promo (2026-10-15 to 2026-11-19): first year ₽1,560, from the second year ₽3,000 («Цена за первый год — 1 560 ₽, со второго года — 3 000 ₽»). Free tier 8 GB, 2 GB max file. Paid 1-4 TB.

egress.terms: No egress meter or per-GB download product is published anywhere in the consumer Cloud UI — public links are «unlimited» in the same sense as Yandex's, confirmed indirectly by the fact that no traffic pack appears in any of the plan descriptions. Treated as free with medium confidence (no explicit verbatim unlimited-traffic claim was found on the pricing surface).

tooling: WebDAV endpoint live (`https://webdav.cloud.mail.ru/` -> 302 to auth). rclone `mailru` backend, alist/OpenList `mailru` driver, desktop sync client, official REST API. Upload up to 100 GB/file on paid tiers.
chaining: One account = one Cloud; 1 TB max per plan, so 20 TB needs 20 accounts — not a real path.
limits_note: The «unlimited» in the marketing is 无限制 auto-upload of phone photos («безлимитная автозагрузка», files moved from the phone do not count against quota) — that is a photo-backup perk, NOT unlimited storage, and it is exactly the trial-vs-steady-state confusion to avoid. Actual paid capacity tops out at 4 TB. Free tier is 8 GB with a 2 GB per-file ceiling.
reliability_note: VK-owned, so politically exposed for a foreign user but technically stable for a decade. The ₽1,560 first-year price IS a trial price — steady state from year two is ₽3,000, a 92 % increase, and must be budgeted at ₽3,000. Plan maximum 4 TB means it cannot host 20 TiB at any price.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.

evidence.proved: «Акция: 15.10.26 — 19.11.26 … Цена за первый год — 1 560 ₽, со второго года — 3 000 ₽»; «1 терабайт пригодится для других файлов»; «С безлимитной автозагрузкой все файлы загрузятся, а в Облаке у вас по-прежнему будет 217 ГБ для любых других файлов»
«Бесплатный объём — 8 ГБ. Максимальный размер одного файла в бесплатной версии — 2 ГБ. Платные тарифы: от 1 до 4 ТБ»

price_per_tb_month: $3.03/TB/mo at 1 TB steady state (₽3,000/yr = $36.33/yr). Trial year: $1.58/TB/mo (₽1,560 = $18.89). At 5 TB and 20 TB: NOT AVAILABLE — the product ceiling is 4 TB, so no 5 TB or 20 TB price exists. Egress free.
